verdict.rationale: Quo's pricing page lists first-party HubSpot and Salesforce integrations, so a native CRM connector exists. Nothing in the evidence describes what those integrations do: automatic logging of calls and texts, or matching activity to the right CRM contact. The API and MCP server are developer building blocks and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documentation that calls and texts sync automatically to the CRM, contact-matching behavior, coverage of call and text sync details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, calls and texts log to my CRM automatically against the right contact
